Female |location = |affiliation = |TV actor =See [[#Behind the scenes|below]] }} The '''birthday party guests''' are characters {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== The party guests are a group of children and adults attending the birthday of [[Roy Spencer]] at [[Bob Spencer|Bob]] and [[Ronda Spencer]]'s house at [[Hollywood Hills]] on October 23, [[Timeline (2050-2099)#2077|2077]]. Two of the guests are [[Frank (TV series)|Frank]] and his [[Frank's daughter|daughter]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== At Roy's birthday party, the guests watch [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] perform a lasso trick for them all on his horse, [[Sugarfoot]]. After the act is finished, Mrs. Spencer brings the guests inside for the birthday cake, where they sing happy birthday to Roy and then eat the cake. The children then start watching ''[[Grognak the Barbarian]]'' on TV after Mrs. Spencer changes the channel to avoid hearing a [[weather newscaster]] forecast doom and gloom about the possibility of nuclear war. As the party guests enjoy their slices of cake, a bomb is dropped off in the distance, causing the glass windows in the living room to break and shatter. The panicking guests start fleeing the scene. ==Appearances== The party guests appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==Behind the scenes== The unnamed party guests are portrayed by various uncredited background performers, including [[Emmaline Gioia]] and [[Milani Stella]]. {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
